calls.reason: TheAgentCompany documents capability failures, while SHRM reports IBM replacing HR workers. Neither establishes why replacement remained limited or tests the unspecified claims by Amodei and Altman.

The New York Fed found AI layoffs at just 1% of surveyed service firms and no manufacturers. Together with the ILO's finding of limited full automation, this supports the broad point, despite geographic and timing limits.

Futurism's conversation screenshots led psychiatrist Nina Vasan to identify worsening delusions. Moore's experiments also found delusion-reinforcing responses, supporting the ordinary reading that chatbots aggravated some users' crises.

SignalFire documents declining graduate hiring but does not isolate premature AI replacement or AI-driven training cuts. The limited search also cannot establish Zitron's sweeping assertion that credible evidence was absent.
